{{Quote|Some refreshment, Jabba?"''<br />''"Thank you. Something crunchy?'' [&hellip;] ''Ah, thank you, Highness.|Prince Xizor and Jabba the Hutt|<ref name="Shadows of the Empire (novel)">[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (novel)|''Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire'' novel]]</ref>}}
A '''serving droid''' in the employ of [[Dark Prince]] [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]] and the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] crime syndicate once tended to a meeting between Xizor and the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] within [[Xizor's Palace]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3.5 ABY]]. The [[Service droid/Legends|serving droid]] presented Jabba with a tray of [[Insectoid/Legends|insectoids]] and vile liquids that Hutts were known to favor.
